# @tcbs/react-native-ondevice-ai

> React Native bindings for Google LiteRT-LM 0.16.0, on-device multimodal Gemma inference, and model-file lifecycle management.

Canonical AI coding instructions: ./AGENTS.md
Project overview and usage: ./README.md
Architecture and invariants: ./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
Public API map: ./docs/API.md
Build and runtime troubleshooting: ./docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md
Contribution workflow: ./CONTRIBUTING.md
Public TypeScript surface: ./src/index.ts
Public types: ./src/types.ts

Scope note: model weights are not bundled. YOLO and object detection are not
part of this package. New Architecture support currently uses React Native's
legacy-module interop and is not a TurboModule implementation.
